messages:
Alex (eng): Quick follow-up from the all-hands — where's the published RCA for yesterday's routing outage? I only see the draft.
Mira (SRE): Published now: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-042 — root cause is a stale routing policy + model variant alias mismatch, details in the doc.
Sanjay (product): Thanks. Can we get a 2-3 sentence summary for customer comms? The RCA is long.
Mira (SRE): TL;DR: router alias mapping drifted after a registry tagging change; fallback logic didn't apply because variant IDs changed. Impact: 3.5 hrs of elevated latency for some dedicated pools in us-west2. We're drafting the customer note now.
Alex (eng): Do we know if the mismatch came from the registry tagging change or from a rollout script? Which PR introduced the variant rename?
Priya (infra): It was the registry tagging PR (#4217). Router assumed stable alias-to-variant mapping; PR changed naming scheme. Hotfix pinned behavior, PR merged: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4224
Jamie (CEO): Two asks from leadership: 1) explicit owners + deadlines for action items; 2) what policy changes will prevent recurrence?
Mira (SRE): Good call. Short answers: owners below; we'll add an automated alias sanity check to the rollout pipeline so alias-variant mismatches fail pre-deploy.
Mira (SRE): Action 1: Update router runbook with alias verification checklist and recovery steps — owner: Priya (infra) — ETA: 2026-04-02.
Mira (SRE): Action 2: Add canary validation job to run alias sanity checks as part of deploys — owner: Alex (eng) — ETA: 2026-03-30.
Mira (SRE): Action 3: Publish customer incident summary and notify impacted accounts — owner: Sanjay (product) — ETA: 2026-03-29.
Alex (eng): I'll open a PR template for alias checks. Example snippet for the validation job:
```
# verify-alias.sh
curl -s $MODEL_REGISTRY/api/aliases | jq '.aliases[] | select(.name==$ENV_ALIAS)'
```
Sanjay (product): opsbot, can you surface the list of impacted accounts so we can prioritize outreach?
opsbot: Impact list created: 14 accounts flagged. Internal link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-042
Priya (infra): Starting runbook edits now; will link PR in this thread when ready :thumbsup:
Jamie (CEO): Thanks. Please escalate any blockers to me directly. We'll review progress in the next all-hands follow-up slot. :eyes:
Mira (SRE): I've added the RCA and action items to the all-hands follow-up doc: https://redwood.internal/allhands/2026-03-25/followups — tracker has owners and ETAs.
Alex (eng): I'll pair with Priya today to implement the validation job and add test coverage.
Priya (infra): Opening runbook PR and tagging @Mira @Alex for review.
Sanjay (product): Drafting customer note; will post to #customer-comms for review by EOD.
Mira (SRE): Final note: if anyone updates owners or ETAs, update the follow-up tracker. Marking this thread as the live all-hands action tracker for this incident. :white_check_mark:
